desc: Leonard and Penny are walking up some stairs and Leonard is talking to Penny while she is eating ice scream.
Leonard and Penny kiss in the hall and a camera on the wall watches them.
A shot of Leonard kissing Penny through a camera view.
Penny kissed Leonard on the cheek, with ice cream in her hands, and walked towards the door.
When Leonard walks in the apartment, Howard and Raj sit back on the couch and try to pretend like they weren't spying on him.
Sheldon, in a blue plaid shirt, is sitting at his desk and puts a pencil in a pencil cup.
Raj is sitting next to Howard, who is wearing a purple shirt, when they lean over to the laptop in front of them.
Sheldon, in a blue plaid shirt, walks over to Raj and Howard, with a book in his hand.
Leonard, in a suit, takes white cards out of his pocket and shows them to Raj and Howard.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, folds a red shirt and places it on top of other folded shirts in a laundry room.
Penny, in a pink shirt, walks through the door carrying a laundry basket and puts it on the laundry machine.
Penny, in a pink shirt, pours laundry detergent into the washing machine.
Penny in pink shirt, takes the basket full of laundry and dumps it into the laundry machine.
Penny points her finger at Sheldon while Sheldon is folding a blue shirt, in a laundry room.
Penny massages her wrists, while standing next to Sheldon at a laundry room.
Sheldon and Leonard walk up the stairs to their apartment landing, walking past white flowers near the apartment doors.
Sheldon, in a mint green shirt, looks panicked and quickly turns and runs upstairs away from Leonard.
Sheldon's eyes and mouth begin to twitch uncontrollably, while he wears a mint green shirt.
Sheldon, in a mint green shirt, grabs Penny at the restaurant by the arm to pull her away.
Sheldon, in a mint green shirt, holds up both of his index fingers to either side of his head.
Sheldon, in a mint green shirt, with a black bag on his shoulder, enters the room where Leonard is standing at the fridge.
Leonard jumps onto the couch with a can in hands and lies on it.
Sheldon, in a mint green shirt, walks towards the grey couch with a drink in his hand.
Sheldon says something to Raj which make Raj give him a very dirty look.
Howard in maroon pajamas, answers the door and Raj leaves Sheldon at the doorway and leaves quickly.
Sheldon stands up from the floor next to Howard, in maroon pajamas, and gets in the bed, arranging the covers and pillow comfortably.
Howard  in maroon pajamas, lies down on the blue air mattress.
Howard grabs his pillow and puts it over his face.
Howard in maroon pajamas, throws the bag off his shoulder and drops it on the floor in front of Leonard.
Sheldon in green plaid pajamas, is leaning against his desk, propping himself up with one hand, and holding his hip.
Sheldon in green plaid pajamas, slumps from the headrest of the armchair down into the chair and makes a shushing gesture.
Leonard, in a red robe, clenches his hands into fists and puts them up to his face out of frustration.
Sheldon in green plaid pajamas, lifts his right hand and stares at his fingers.
Penny in a green tank top, is holding a flyer while talking to Leonard who points his finger at it.
Penny in a green tank top, closes her apartment door in Leonard's surprised face.
Leonard leaves Penny's apartment door to go inside his apartment and look up at the camera.
